title: user-scripts configuration
description: JSON form of the values declared in the repository's config file. Scalars mirror ${VAR:-default} entries; arrays are config-only. Paths are literal strings; a JSON consumer must expand or resolve them itself.

ARCHIVE_HEADER.description: Prefix of archive filenames before the timestamp.

STATE_DIR.description: Directory holding maintenance countdown and pending state.

EXCLUDES.description: Paths passed to tar as exclusions.

MAX_BACKUP_AGE_DAYS.description: Age in days at which the newest backup counts as overdue.

MIN_SNAPSHOTS.description: Minimum number of Timeshift snapshots required.

MAX_SNAPSHOT_AGE_DAYS.description: Age in days at which the newest snapshot counts as too old.

GIT_CHECKER.description: Path to the executable used for Git repository checks.

DAYS_DUE.description: Maintenance interval in days; 0 makes maintenance due immediately.

SERVER.description: Remote host for maintenance checks; empty disables them.

SERVER_USER.description: SSH user for SERVER; empty skips remote maintenance with a warning.

REMOTE_STATE_DIR.description: Remote state directory relative to the remote home.

SEARCH_DIR.description: Root directory searched for Git repositories.

IGNORE_DIRS.description: Subtrees skipped by the Git repository search.

REMOTE_SERVERS.description: user@host targets for remote deployment; empty disables it.

REMOTE_INSTALL_DIR.description: Destination directory for scripts deployed to remote hosts.
